NOS-DOS Quick Start
===================

5 MINUTES TO A WORKING DOS ENVIRONMENT
---------------------------------------

STEP 0: INSTALL (first time only)
  Run the installer once to set up NOS-DOS on the virtual hard disk.

  VirtualBox:
    See VBOX.TXT for the full step-by-step guide. In brief:
      1. Create a new VM (Other/DOS, 64 MB RAM, IDE controller).
      2. Attach nosdos-blank.vmdk as the hard disk.
      3. Attach nosdos.iso as the optical drive.
      4. Boot order: Optical first, Hard Disk second.
      5. Start the VM and follow the installer screens.
      6. When done: Devices -> Optical Drives -> Remove Disk,
         then press Enter. The VM reboots into NOS-DOS.

    IMPORTANT: Use nosdos-blank.vmdk -- do not create your own
    blank disk. The installer requires a pre-formatted disk.

  VMware:
    Attach nosdos-blank.vmdk as the hard disk and nosdos.iso as
    the CD-ROM. Boot order: CD first. Follow the installer prompts.
    When done: VM -> Settings -> CD/DVD -> uncheck "Connected",
    then press Enter in the VM to reboot from the hard disk.

  QEMU (Linux / macOS):
    Run:  ./run-qemu.sh          (installer ISO boots automatically)
    When the installer says to remove the disc, close the QEMU window.
    Then run:  ./run-qemu-hdd.sh  (boots from the installed HDD, no ISO)
    Use run-qemu-hdd.sh for all future sessions.

  QEMU (Windows):
    Run:  run-qemu.bat           (installer ISO boots automatically)
    When the installer says to remove the disc, close the QEMU window.
    Then run:  run-qemu-hdd.bat  (boots from the installed HDD, no ISO)
    Use run-qemu-hdd.bat for all future sessions.

STEP 1: BOOT
  After installation, NOS-DOS boots in under 10 seconds and lands in
  NOS-SHELL. On the very first boot, NOS-DETECT runs to configure
  hardware — this takes a few extra seconds then reboots once more.

STEP 2: NAVIGATE NOS-SHELL
  Arrow keys   Move cursor in file panel
  Tab          Switch between left and right panel
  Enter        Open directory or run file
  F1           Help (this documentation)
  F3           View file
  F5           Copy file
  F6           Move/rename file
  F7           Create directory
  F8           Delete file
  F9           Application launcher
  F10          Quit to DOS prompt
  F12          Drop to DOS shell (type EXIT to return)
  Ctrl+R       Refresh panels

STEP 3: CONNECT TO THE INTERNET
  Press F12 to open a DOS prompt, then:
    NNET DHCP          Obtain an IP address
    NNET STATUS        Verify connection
    NNET PING 8.8.8.8  Test connectivity
    EXIT               Return to NOS-SHELL

STEP 4: INSTALL AN APPLICATION
    NPKG UPDATE            Download package index
    NPKG SEARCH word       Find word processors
    NPKG INSTALL GALAXY    Install Galaxy Write
    NPKG LIST              See installed packages
  The application appears in the F9 launcher automatically.

STEP 5: EXCHANGE FILES WITH YOUR HOST
    NBRIDGE MOUNT          Mount shared folder on H:\
    NBRIDGE DIRS           Create INBOX/OUTBOX/PRINT/CLIP
  Copy files to H:\OUTBOX\ and they appear on your host desktop
  (run watch_outbox.py from the host_helpers/ folder on the host).

STEP 6: PLAY A GAME
    NPKG INSTALL DOOM      Install DOOM Shareware
    NOSPLAY DOOM           Launch with correct speed/sound profile
  Or press F9 and select the game from the launcher.

KEY FILES AND LOCATIONS
-----------------------
  C:\NOS\SHELL\SHELL.EXE     NOS-SHELL (starts automatically)
  C:\NOS\SHELL\LAUNCHER.CFG  F9 launcher entries
  C:\NOS\SYSTEM\             System utilities
  C:\NOS\NPKG\INSTALLED.DB   Installed package registry
  C:\APPS\                   Productivity applications
  C:\GAMES\                  Games
  C:\USER\                   Your personal files
  C:\TEMP\                   Temporary files

GETTING HELP
------------
  F1 in NOS-SHELL     Open documentation viewer
  NPKG /?             Package manager help
  NNET /?             Networking help
  NBRIDGE /?          Host bridge help
  NOSPLAY /?          Game launcher help
